newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Newell Co targets raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Newell Co targets raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it raised its six-month price target for Newell Co to $37 from $34 and its 18-month target to $43 from $41.
-- EVEREN said the move is based on a combination of recent market appreciation, continued strong fundamental outlook and the recent pickup in acquisition activity.
-- Newell shares continue to be rated outperform the intermediate and long terms, EVEREN said.
-- Newell is a consumer products manufacturing company.
-- Its shares closed down 1/4 Thursday at 37.
